grammar: UserNobody14/tree-sitter-dart at commit be07cf71 (MIT, untagged), dart.wasm.gz 205,433 bytes gzip (914,734 raw), 373 peak module pages; 219 of the 225 files parse without an ERROR or MISSING node and the six that do (all in http2) still yield every definition. Extraction is parse-bound: 1.27 MB/CPU-s (the reading's floor is 1.0), and a query that captures only the root reads 1.02 MB/CPU-s on http2 under a machine load average above 20.

L1 and L2 oracle: scip-dart 1.7.0 (tier A, Dart SDK 3.13.4, calibration/oracles/scip-dart), one index per package of eight pure-Dart packages (felangel/bloc bloc-v9.2.1 packages bloc, bloc_test, bloc_concurrency; dart-lang/http http-v1.5.0 pkgs http, http_parser, http2, web_socket_channel, http_multi_server), scored with -scip-defs, measured as cloned after `dart pub get` inside each package. universal-ctags 6.2.1 has no Dart parser, so no tier-B oracle exists; the packages that need the Flutter SDK (flutter_bloc, angular_bloc, cupertino_http, cronet_http, ok_http) are not measured, nor are hydrated_bloc and replay_bloc, whose workspace example depends on it.

L1: 2,064 SCIP definitions and 2,064 fathom definitions in the kind intersection, 2,063 matched (sym_recall and sym_precision .9995, kind_agreement 1, range_agreement 1 on all 2,063, every one of 1,731 callables signed). The two misses: web_socket_channel's `signKey` (a comment between the signature and its `=>` body breaks the sibling adjacency the query relies on) and http's library-private extension type `_IterableHeaders` (scip-dart writes a private definition as a local symbol of unspecified kind, which is not read as a definition). scip:namespace (29) is a file or an `import ... as p` prefix and has no fathom symbol. A private member is a `local N` symbol in scip-dart; its kind says what it is, so a private field, accessor, method or variable is read as a definition (SCIPDefs) and a call inside a private method belongs to it (SCIPOptions.PrivateMembers).

L2: 3,131 call pairs in the truth, 3,122 found (call_recall .9971), 3,236 fathom pairs, 3,122 in the truth (call_precision .9648). 295 callable references are left out of the truth because no call is written at their range (a tear-off such as `onError: c.addError`, an operator, the super(...) of an initializer). The dialect's pairs outside the index are calls through a function-typed parameter or field (`emit(state)`, `handler(e)`, `onError(...)`), which are call sites in the source and references to a parameter in the index.

L3 and L4 (LB-Q-dart-rest): import_resolution is not computed by the harness. file_edge_precision .9847 (129 of 131 fathom file edges are in the index) but file_edge_recall .108 (129 of 1,194 SCIP file edges) against the .25 good floor: the dialect's edges come from call sites bound by an import, and the index also has an edge for every type reference (extends, a field's or parameter's type, an annotation), which the tags engine counts and does not store; an import through a barrel file (`package:bloc/bloc.dart` exports lib/src/*.dart) resolves to a file that defines no symbol and `export` is not followed (bloc/packages/bloc has 219 SCIP file edges and none from fathom). def_mapping .9995 is excellent; typed_recall .4331 against .85: 9,076 of the 19,736 in-index references (46%) target a parameter, a type parameter or a local variable, which no extractor emits, and a reference inside a local variable's initializer has that unmapped local as its enclosing definition.
disposition: partial: target L4, met L2 (L1 excellent, L2 excellent) on eight pure-Dart packages of felangel/bloc bloc-v9.2.1 and dart-lang/http http-v1.5.0, 225 files: sym_recall .9995, sym_precision .9995, kind_agreement 1, range_agreement 1, signature_coverage 1 (1,731 callables), call_recall .9971, call_precision .9648 (scip-dart 1.7.0, tier A), 1.27 MB/CPU-s, 0 faults, 373 peak module pages, dart.wasm.gz 205,433 bytes. L3 is not met: the harness computes no import_resolution, and file_edge_recall is .108 against .25 (precision .9847): the index has a file edge for every type reference and for every import through a barrel file, and the dialect's edges come from call sites bound by an import (`export` is not followed, a type reference is counted and not stored). L4 is not met: def_mapping .9995 is excellent but typed_recall is .4331 against .85, because 46% of the index's references target a parameter, a type parameter or a local variable no extractor emits and a reference inside a local variable's initializer has that unmapped local as its enclosing definition. Trigger: the harness computing import_resolution, the file resolver following `export` and the tags engine storing type references, and internal/scip attributing an edge from an unmapped local to its nearest mapped enclosing definition with the harness counting only references to symbols an extractor can emit.
